constraints.description: Real Gate credentials enforce issuer, audience, tenant, subject, channel and object authorization against the selected Keto build.
Token expiry, authority loss and protected shape cancellation stop server-produced output inside the accepted 5000 ms lifetime.

validation.validation_method: subscription, shape revocation and lease timing tests

constraints.description: Key and tuple cache rotation cannot restore stale authority after an invalidation or bounded age.

validation.validation_method: Ory verifier rotation and Keto generation-fence tests

constraints.description: Cedar uses the c003-selected fixed exact patch and policy parity tests pass.

validation.validation_method: Cargo lock inspection and frf-policy-cedar tests

constraints.description: Rust, shell, fixture and OpenSpec quality gates pass locally with touched files no larger than 500 lines.

validation.validation_method: format, strict Clippy, tests, Shellcheck, size, diff and OpenSpec checks

global_rules: Runtime tests execute locally; CI results are not evidence.
The ASO clock ends at the last server-produced frame or cancellation preventing the next frame.
Ephemeral credentials and owned runtime resources are removed after each integration run.
termination_conditions: Independent review has no unresolved critical or warning finding.
